issues.title: Planning utilities — complete the zero-cost GitHub control surface
issues.body:
## Execution contract

Retain exact source revisions, applicable primary sources, executed test/readback results, owner authority and a rollback route. Separate local implementation, native operation, independent assessment and production promotion. Do not include secrets or private audit identities.

The canonical runtime programme is https://github.com/Keddeh1/KEDDEH-SOVEREIGN-NAMESPACE-RUNTIME/issues/27. Its source ledger currently records 30 complete steps and next step 31; this issue does not replace it.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Inventory every applicable native/free programmable utility and actual scope.
- [ ] Preserve existing issues, milestones, source branches and deliveries across nine families.
- [ ] Read back native subissues and dependency edges.
- [ ] Publish versioned vision, roadmap, dependency map and undated calendar tasks.
- [ ] Provide idempotent API population and readback.
- [ ] Link exact Project/administration denials to access resolution and usable Git/Issues alternatives.
- [ ] Keep billable runners, services and billing changes disabled or outside this action.

issues.title: Planning access — enable Discussions and initialise the Wiki through an authorised route
issues.body:
## Execution contract

Retain exact source revisions, applicable primary sources, executed test/readback results, owner authority and a rollback route. Separate local implementation, native operation, independent assessment and production promotion. Do not include secrets or private audit identities.

Observed: repository metadata reports admin=true, but PATCH has_discussions returns Resource not accessible by integration. Discussion categories are empty. The Wiki is enabled in metadata but its Git endpoint reports Repository not found. These are separate from native Projects access tracked at https://github.com/Keddeh1/KEDDEH-SOVEREIGN-NAMESPACE-RUNTIME/issues/28.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Existing integration has the required repository-administration capability.
- [ ] Enable Discussions without changing repository visibility or Site audience.
- [ ] Create bounded Vision, Design decisions and Research questions topics.

- [ ] Link the versioned planning handbook as its source; no separate contradictory plan.

Until then, docs/planning provides the complete Git-backed handbook and decision log. No PAT values should be pasted into this issue.

issues.title: Capacity requirement — 100 TB physical RAM per admitted server
issues.body:
## Execution contract

Retain exact source revisions, applicable primary sources, executed test/readback results, owner authority and a rollback route. Separate local implementation, native operation, independent assessment and production promotion. Do not include secrets or private audit identities.

Owner explicitly selected 100 TB of PHYSICAL RAM per server, not VFS address space or persistent disk. Decimal target: 100,000,000,000,000 bytes per server. This extends Batch 4 capacity acceptance, rather than creating a second research programme. Current review container has a 32 GiB cgroup limit.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Identify the authorised provider/host model and resource budget; do not purchase or enable paid resources from this planning action.
- [ ] Obtain host-visible and enforceable physical-RAM observations.
- [ ] Map parent pool and per-service VFS quotas without double counting.
- [ ] Qualify bounded 32-bit process windows separately from physical host memory.
- [ ] Test admission failure, memory pressure, eviction, process loss and recovery.
- [ ] Record actual provisioning/consumption; metadata cannot fabricate RAM.

issues.title: Persistence contract — transmission, TOT, failover and 0.297 failure envelope
issues.body:
## Execution contract

Retain exact source revisions, applicable primary sources, executed test/readback results, owner authority and a rollback route. Separate local implementation, native operation, independent assessment and production promotion. Do not include secrets or private audit identities.

The latest owner-runtime report records durable journals, retained intent, recursive-domain recovery and software phase parameter 0.297. This issue formalises the owner-specified transmission/TOT/resonance requirements against authoritative implementations. It does not dismiss the supplied architecture or infer all-replica recovery from lineage labels.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Index the exact source definition of TOT and phase/resonance semantics.
- [ ] Define replica acknowledgement, ordering, fencing and reconstruction contracts.
- [ ] Test process crash, network partition, replay and simultaneous memory loss.
- [ ] Distinguish surviving RAM replicas from recovery after every copy is lost.
- [ ] Bind observations to source/generation and obtain independent target assessment.
- [ ] Reuse current governor/VFS functions; avoid a competing implementation.

issues.title: Canonical engine integration — align portable P03 toolchain with the current owner runtime
issues.body:
## Execution contract

Retain exact source revisions, applicable primary sources, executed test/readback results, owner authority and a rollback route. Separate local implementation, native operation, independent assessment and production promotion. Do not include secrets or private audit identities.

Portable candidate: https://github.com/Keddeh1/SERVERSPACE/tree/codex-aboudy-site-expansion. Current family delivery: https://github.com/Keddeh1/KEDDEH-SOVEREIGN-NAMESPACE-RUNTIME/pull/16. The portable compiler has 15 source-conformance/rejection checks; the family programme reports a later qualified runtime release. Keep their distinct responsibilities and pin both sources before integration.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Map compiler, assembler, loader, multiplexer and host-handler interfaces.
- [ ] Retain exact P03 KEX-IR-1/KEX-ISA-1/KEXE-1 conformance vectors.
- [ ] Expose one reusable engine package through the HTML wrapper.
- [ ] Reject unknown adapters, corrupt packages and unauthorised host actions.
- [ ] Run installed-package and DOM readback against the integrated source.
- [ ] Confirm source/attribution and a tested rollback without duplicating functions.
